_README: Copy this file to config.json and fill it in. config.json is gitignored — never commit it.
Every value can be overridden by an environment variable: BBW_<UPPER_DOT_PATH>.
Precedence: environment variable > config.json > this file's defaults.
Check what is set without printing any secret:  tools/config.py check
Read one value:                                  tools/config.py get vps.host
Export for shell scripts:                        eval "$(tools/config.py env)"

researcher._note: Identifies you to the programs you test. handle + header_value are your attribution identity, permitted in ONE place only: the configured attribution header (header_name), injected by vps-run.py — never a URL, body, cookie or other header. config.py hides handle/header_value/contact_email/protected_aliases from check/get/env and nothing writes them to a target brain. RECOMMENDED: put your real name and any nicknames in protected_aliases — that is the ONLY way the mechanical guard can catch a name a model picked up from chat and tried to send; without it, the always-loaded rule is the only control.

vps._note: Where heavy tooling runs. enabled=false leaves passive OSINT, reasoning, request analysis, and manual browser work available; active tool-driven recon phases stop until a VPS exists.

_note: All optional. Missing keys degrade coverage; they never cause a silent empty result —
a phase that needs a key it does not have must say so, not report zero findings.
github accepts a list so subfinder/github-subdomains can rotate on rate limit.
pdcp = ProjectDiscovery Cloud. zoomeye = subfinder's 'zoomeyeapi'. intelx here is the API key, not the INTELX_URL endpoint.
Workspace-wide floors. A program's own limit ALWAYS wins when it is stricter —
targets/<t>/scope.md is the authority, this is only the fallback.

tooling._note: Local endpoints the workflows may use. Burp proxy is optional.

_note: Fire-and-forget event notifications to any webhook channel: Discord, Slack, Teams,
ntfy, Gotify, Telegram — anything that accepts an HTTP POST. A channel is
{name, url, headers?, template?}; the default body carries both 'text' and 'content'
keys so a bare URL works for Slack/Teams (text) and Discord (content) without a template.
URLs contain credentials and are never printed — `config.py check` shows only SET.
strict: replace the target name with '(redacted)' — a webhook is a third party.
on_run_failed / on_run_completed: which run events notify. Failures default on,
per-run completion defaults off (a long session would ping forty times).
Events: monitor-delta, monitor-quarantined, run-failed, run-completed, tech-watch,
runbook-digest. Test yours:  tools/notify.py test --target acme
